note: kg-policy: the format spellings kg refuses that Emacs accepts. The +, space and # flags and N$ field numbers raise `invalid format operation`; (format "%c" 0) raises where Emacs writes a NUL byte, because nothing kg stores in a string may contain one. The expr is the list of rejected spellings as text, in phase8-reader-policy-rejections' shape, since an error message has no Emacs answer to compare against.
